name: io.github.nic01asFr/gristcoder
title: Grist Coder
description: Turns a Grist document into a complete business application: tables and formulas, HTML/React artefacts served as custom widgets, SQL and UserActions, and outbound webhooks. Self-hosted; published artefacts keep working once the server is gone.

headers.name: Authorization
headers.description: Bearer <Grist API key>. Not needed from the Grist widget, which authenticates with a document access token.

headers.name: X-Grist-Site
headers.description: Base URL of the Grist instance, e.g. https://docs.getgrist.com

environmentVariables.name: HOST_URL
environmentVariables.description: Public URL of this server. Written into the document's widget sections and webhook URLs, so localhost only works for a local setup.

environmentVariables.name: GRIST_SITE_URL
environmentVariables.description: Grist instance used to resolve an API key to a user when no widget session is open.

environmentVariables.name: LLM_PROXY_ALLOWED_HOSTS
environmentVariables.description: Comma-separated allowlist for the outbound LLM proxy used by the in-widget agent. Empty disables the endpoint, which is the safe default.

environmentVariables.name: WEBHOOK_SECRET
environmentVariables.description: Shared secret checked on /webhook-receive. Recommended whenever the server is reachable from outside.
